property.name: yarn.resourcemanager.hostname
property.description: Hostname of the ResourceManager. Replace with your master node hostname.

property.name: yarn.resourcemanager.webapp.address
property.description: ResourceManager web UI address. Access at: http://m-1:8088

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.aux-services
property.description: Shuffle service for MapReduce. Required for MapReduce to work with YARN.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.resource.memory-mb
property.description:
Total physical memory (in MB) to be made available to running containers.
For 4GB VM (Standard_B2s): Total RAM: 4096 MB OS Reserve: 1024 MB YARN Available: 3072 MB
For 8GB VM (Standard_D2s_v3): Total RAM: 8192 MB OS Reserve: 2048 MB YARN Available: 6144 MB
Adjust based on your VM size!

property.name: yarn.scheduler.maximum-allocation-mb
property.description: Maximum memory that can be allocated for a single container. Should match yarn.nodemanager.resource.memory-mb

property.name: yarn.scheduler.minimum-allocation-mb
property.description: Minimum memory that can be allocated for a container.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.resource.cpu-vcores
property.description: Number of CPU cores available to YARN on each node. For Standard_B2s: 2 For Standard_D2s_v3: 2

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.pmem-check-enabled
property.description: Whether to check and enforce physical memory limits. Set to false if containers are killed due to memory overruns. Not recommended for production.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.vmem-check-enabled
property.description: Whether to check and enforce virtual memory limits. Often disabled as virtual memory usage can be unpredictable.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.vmem-pmem-ratio
property.description: Ratio between virtual memory and physical memory. Containers can use up to 2.1x their physical memory allocation in virtual memory. Increase if containers are killed for vmem.

property.name: yarn.log-aggregation-enable
property.description: Enable log aggregation. Logs from all containers will be aggregated and stored in HDFS after application completes.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.local-dirs
property.description: Local directories for NodeManager intermediate data. Can specify multiple directories separated by commas.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.log-dirs
property.description: Local directories where NodeManager stores container logs.

property.name: yarn.timeline-service.enabled
property.description: Enable Timeline Service for application history. Set to true if you need detailed application history.
